services.name: Sunset Sails
services.desc: Our sailing curriculum is designed to meet the needs of each individual. Some people are looking for an introduction to sailing and others are wanting to prepare to bareboat in remote locations such as the Virgin Islands. There are many sailing certification courses available each of which have different levels of recognition within and outside of the United States. The most recognized is that offered by the United States Coast Guard. If you are looking for a certification, you need to closely study the credentials offered by each of the organizations offering certification and then make your selection. blurb: Guests can book private charters on the largest sailing yacht on Lake Travis with a flexible itinerary including sailing, anchoring, swimming, and sunbathing. Shared sunset sails are offered every Saturday for 2.5 hours starting an hour and a half before sunset. Destination charters to places like the Virgin Islands and Mediterranean are available with full turnkey cruising experiences.

quotes.text: We chose the 6 hour boat cruise with a captain Tim for a bachelorette party and it was absolutely incredible! Captain Tim is extremely kind and flexible. He had a ton of fun knowledge about the lake and knew all the great spots. He had a huge cooler for our beverages and snacks and took some really fun photos! We got out to swim in the lake and he had a fun noodle line that we could all hang out on. Lake Travis was also only about 35 mins from Austin, and was extremely easy to access via Uber. I would absolutely book with captain Tim again!

The experience with Captain Tim and Sail Austin was simply perfect!!! I could not have imagined a better choice for a personalized, first class experience! Captain Tim takes every effort to create the day you want and need. He is a master sailor that can create an adrenaline filled exciting sail, or a relaxing cruise across the lake.

WE LOVE CAPTAIN TIM BEST! I contacted him about surprising my husband with a sunset cruise for his 30th birthday, and I couldn't be happier. He was so accommodating and willing to brainstorm ideas with me about how to make it perfect and special. We ended up taking lobster rolls and eating them on board, it was super nice!

This is one of the most exciting things we did all year! Captain Tim is a great host and a fantastic sailor who showed very clearly his competency in the high winds which made our night sail exhilarating! We both highly recommend Sail Austin Charters to anyone and everyone. Thanks again Tim!
